atAGlance: Tôm rim mặn is shrimp simmered salty-sweet, usually with fish sauce caramel, pepper, and rice.
whatItIs: Tôm rim mặn is shrimp simmered down in a salty-sweet fish-sauce caramel until glossy. It is intense, savory, and made to eat with rice.
howToEnjoy: Use rice to catch the glaze, and check whether the shrimp are shell-on. A little cucumber or greens helps balance the salt and sweetness.
howLocalsOrder: Order tôm rim mặn when you want shrimp for rice, not a dry snack. Ask about shells and request extra rice if the glaze is rich.
worthKnowing: Rim means simmered down until concentrated; here it turns shrimp into a sticky rice companion.
goodToKnow: Contains or may contain seafood or shellfish.
travelerCaution: Contains or may contain seafood or shellfish.
